item.title: Aquamarine and emerald are varieties of beryl
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Aquamarine is a blue to greenish-blue beryl, while emerald is the green member of the same mineral family.
EXIMUTC view: Request disclosure of any color-enhancing treatment before comparison.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/aquamarine-description
